name: AUDIT-TW-D1-land-note-no-towns
old: and its own cities, towns, roads and dungeons. Off ends the world at the Bay’s edge.'
new: There are no towns, roads or dungeons there yet.'

old: With Land beyond the Bay on, fast travel reaches them, except into or out of Cyrodiil online.'
new: You can’t travel beyond the Bay.'

name: AUDIT-TW-D3-the-windows-flag-unread
old: continent: this._tamriel || this._zoneMap,   // AUDIT TAMRIEL-WIDE D3
new: continent: false,   // AUDIT TAMRIEL-WIDE D3
note: The world sheet says The Bay over the whole continent again.

name: AUDIT-TW-D3-the-title-the-bays
old: return continent ? t('map.sheet.tamriel', 'Tamriel') : t('map.sheet.bay', 'The Bay');
new: return t('map.sheet.bay', 'The Bay');
note: The strip's world tab is the Bay's whatever the sheet shows.

name: AUDIT-TW-D3-the-title-past-the-core
old: return continent ? t('map.sheet.tamriel', 'Tamriel') : t('map.sheet.bay', 'The Bay');
new: return continent ? 'Tamriel' : t('map.sheet.bay', 'The Bay');
note: The continent's title in English whatever language the player chose.

name: AUDIT-TW-D3-the-lands-suffix-back
old: land: (province) => province,
new: land: (province) => `${province} (beyond the Bay)`,
note: A province past the Bay is an aside to the Bay again.

name: AUDIT-TW-D3-the-places-suffix-back
old: t('map.tamriel.placeKind', '{province} : {place} ({kind})',
new: t('map.tamriel.placeKind', '{province} : {place} ({kind}, beyond the Bay)',
note: A place past the Bay is an aside to the Bay again.

name: AUDIT-TW-D4-the-tale-in-the-bay
old: t('death.line', 'Your tale ends here.')
new: t('death.line', 'Your tale in the Iliac Bay ends here.')
note: A death in Skyrim ends a tale in the Iliac Bay again.

name: AUDIT-TW-D4-the-rise-in-the-bay
old: 'Your body falls. The world is not done with you yet.'
new: 'Your body falls. The Bay is not done with you yet.'
note: A rise in Skyrim is the Bay's again.

name: AUDIT-TW-D5-the-travel-page-kept-to-the-bay
old: '{TravelMap} opens the map of the whole land. Choose a place to travel there. The journey takes days in the game but only a moment for you.',
new: '{TravelMap} opens the map. Choose a place in the Iliac Bay: the journey takes days in the game but a moment for you. Past the Bay, you go there on the Overworld.',
note: The page keeps the travel map's journey to the Bay, as before TRAVEL-EVERYWHERE.

name: AUDIT-TW-D5-the-arena-page-as-it-was
old: 'An arena stands in the Imperial City and in the Iliac Bay\'s westernmost crown city.
new: 'The arena stands in the province\'s capital.
note: The page puts an arena in every province's capital again.

name: AUDIT-TW-D6-the-serpents-bay

note: A serpent slain anywhere is the Bay's to remember again.

name: AUDIT-TW-D6-the-taverns-bay

new: every tavern in the Bay.'

name: AUDIT-TW-D6-the-seas-share
old: 'The sea takes its share.'
new: 'The Bay takes its share.'
note: A crossing lost past the Bay is the Bay's again.

name: AUDIT-TW-D6-the-crews-bay
old: 'Another day on the water.'
new: 'Another day on the Iliac Bay.'
note: A crew past the Bay says it is on the Iliac Bay again.

old: hold seats across Tamriel:
new: hold seats of the Iliac Bay:

name: AUDIT-TW-D6-the-carrack
old: 'Only an Admiralty sells a carrack. The title goes to your Fleet.'
new: 'The only carrack for sale in the Bay. The title goes to your Fleet.'

name: AUDIT-TW-D6-the-wardrobe
old: wordPair('world', () => t('coll.src.world', 'Around Tamriel')),
new: wordPair('world', () => t('coll.src.world', 'Around the Bay')),

name: AUDIT-TW-D6-the-card-table
old: 'Legendary across Tamriel. Bring your best army.'
new: 'Legendary across the Iliac Bay. Bring your best army.'
note: The grandmaster is the Bay's legend again.

old: const rest = more ? `${more} more today across Tamriel` : null;
new: const rest = more ? `${more} more today across the Iliac Bay` : null;

old: raid towns across Tamriel for 2 hours.
new: raid towns across the Bay for 2 hours.
note: The raids' row keeps them to the Bay again.

name: AUDIT-TW-D6-the-sea-fights-row

new: navies sail the Bay.
note: The sea fight's row keeps its ships to the Bay again.
